sponsor_or_proposer: Angola LNG Ltd (Sonangol EP; Chevron Corp; BP PLC / Azule Energy; Eni SpA; TotalEnergies SE)
current_state: Stated intent only. Azule Energy CEO Adriano Mongini (Nov 2024) said Angola LNG 'is already thinking about this expansion, if it's a mini train or one additional train' (~3 MTPA), to capitalize on rising non-associated gas supply from the New Gas Consortium (Quiluma/Maboqueiro). No FID, no FEED award, no separate site selection reported as of this sweep.
missing_threshold_elements: Concrete step (no FID/FEED/permit/contract; verbal intent only). NOTE: this is an EXPANSION of the existing Angola LNG Terminal (GEM TerminalID T100000130245) at Soyo, NOT a new terminal -- if it firms up it routes to a new_unit on that terminal (Discovery SOP §6 expansion-vs-new), never a new_terminals record.
watch_for: FEED contract award, FID, EPC tender, or a formal capacity-addition announcement for the new train/mini-train; confirmation of train size (3 MTPA mini-train vs full additional train).
notes: Corroborated by https://energycapitalpower.com/12b-angola-lng-project-explores-expansion-options/ . Both URLs verified via url_verifier.py (PASS). Feedstock context: New Gas Consortium / Soyo Gas Treatment Plant (first gas 2025/2026) raises gas available to the existing single 5.2 MTPA train (running ~70%), which is what motivates the expansion talk.

candidate_name: Medium-sized LNG import terminal -- Benguela/Lobito or Namibe (gas-to-power)
sponsor_or_proposer: None named (Angola Gas Master Plan / Gesto Energy 'Angola Energy 2025' planning study)
current_state: Conceptual planning-study option. The 'Angola Energy 2025' Gas Master Plan study lists 'a medium-sized LNG terminal in Benguela/Lobito' (and Namibe-area power options) as one of several alternative scenarios for domestic gas-to-power. No developer, no chosen site (Benguela/Lobito OR Namibe), no concrete step. Document is a pre-2025-vintage strategy doc ('not expected availability of this gas on the horizon of 2025'); the active 2025 Gas Master Plan emphasis is on ammonia/methanol/gas-to-power rather than a new LNG import terminal.
missing_threshold_elements: Sponsor (none identified), Location (alternative sites, none selected), Concrete step (planning study only). Fails all three §3 elements.
watch_for: Any sponsor (FSRU operator or domestic utility) attached to an import terminal at Benguela, Lobito, or Namibe; a charter/MOU; or ANPG/government tender. Distinct from the cancelled New Fortress Angola import terminal (GEM TerminalID T100000130823).
notes: URL verified via url_verifier.py (PASS; matched 'LNG terminal' + 'Benguela'). Same source also floats a possible new liquefaction plant 'south of Luanda - in Benguela or Porto Amboim' contingent on future gas discoveries, explicitly not expected near-term -- folded into this monitor entry as the same speculative master-plan tier, not a separate lead.
